finding: Authenticated source bytes and semantic validation must be joined to the canonical parser by a fail-closed construction boundary that independently reconciles parser record count and canonical mapping digest before dataset promotion.

claim_status.observed: UTS #39 17.0.0 revision 32 and the current confusables data format were inspected from Unicode primary sources.
claim_status.inferred: A parser can silently drop, duplicate, or transform records even when source bytes and pre-parser semantics are valid.
claim_status.implemented: A parser-independent construction boundary now rejects unverified bytes, invalid UTF-8, semantic failures, parser shape drift, record-count divergence, and canonical-digest divergence.
claim_status.unresolved: The repository canonical parser and pinned production Unicode 17 payload remain unlocated through the available indexed search surface.

verification.method: node --test on an isolated exact copy of the committed implementation and test source
coverage: mandatory stage order and promotion envelope

falsification_routes: Run the committed tests in an authenticated checkout and compare exact output.
Run the pinned Unicode 17 payload through the boundary and retain source SHA-256, record count, and canonical digest.
Integrate the actual canonical parser and demonstrate that independent count and digest reconciliation pass.
